_about: Be Bodywise products relevant to underarm darkness, with ingredient lists copied from bebodywise.com product pages scraped 17 Oct 2026 (raw pages in research/raw/apps/product-*.md). Prices are list prices on that date. Used by the shelf check (pairing rules) and the product pick. Re-scrape before the demo; prices and formulas change.

severity_scale._note: Bodywise's own selector on these pages: Odour/Mild, Odour/Moderate, Odour/Severe (3+ shades darker than skin tone).
severity_scale.question: Next to your inner arm, your underarm skin looks:

products.name: 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On
products.inci: Aqua, Propylene Glycol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Lactic Acid, Sodium Lactate, Glycerin, Lysolecithin (and) Sclerotium Gum (and) Xanthan Gum (and) Pullulan, Mandelic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Aqua (and) Sodium Benzoate (and) Potassium Sorbate, Polysorbate 20, Alpha Arbutin, Tocopheryl Acetate, Silica, Perfume
products.inci_note: The No Fragrance variant lists the same formula without Perfume (see the kit page).
products.when: daily, on clean dry skin; can be used twice a day
products.judge_after: 3 months (Bodywise), first fair check at 8 weeks (Fair Trial)
products.brand_claims: 113 women, 3 months: 88% noticed reduction of dark underarms; 95% felt fresh through the day

products.name: 6% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On
products.for: Odour and stubborn pigmentation; Bodywise calls it its most effective roll-on
products.inci: Aqua, Lactic Acid, Propylene Glycol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Glycerin, Perfume, Aqua (and) Sodium Benzoate (and) Potassium Sorbate, Kojic Acid, Mandelic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Silica, Alpha Arbutin, Morus Alba (Mulberry) Extract, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Acacia Senegal Gum (and) Xanthan Gum, Polysorbate 20, Xanthan Gum, Sodium lactate
products.when: daily, on clean skin; up to twice a day
warnings: Do not apply on broken or irritated skin

products.name: Pigmentation Repair Cream
products.for: Dark patches on body folds: neck, knees, elbows, underarms, thighs
products.inci: Aqua, Cetostearyl Alcohol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Propylene Glycol, Cetearyl Alcohol & Ceteareth-20, Lactic Acid, Glycerin, PEG-100 Stearate (and) Glyceryl Stearate, Urea, Sorbitan Monostearate, Niacinamide, Sodium hydroxide, Kojic Acid dipalmitate, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Fragrance, Carbomer, Disodium Edetate, Retinol
products.when: pea-sized amount on clean skin; the kit uses it at night
flags: contains retinol: ask a doctor if pregnant or trying

products.name: Underarm Pigmentation Kit - No Fragrance
products.for: Odour and severe pigmentation (3+ shades darker)
flags: 'No Fragrance' refers to the roll-on; the cream's listed ingredients include Fragrance

products.name: Advanced Underarm Pigmentation Kit
products.for: Odour and severe pigmentation, stronger formula

related_not_for_underarm_darkness.name: 10% Niacinamide Body Lotion
related_not_for_underarm_darkness.inci: Aqua, Niacinamide, Propylene Glycol, Aloe Vera Extract, Glycerin, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Vitamin E, Polyacrylamide & C13-14 Isoparaffin & Laureth-7, Phenoxyethanol (and) Ethylhexylglycerin, Almond Oil, Coconut Oil, Fragrance, Grapeseed Oil, Polyacrylate Crosspolymer-6
related_not_for_underarm_darkness.brand_says: An everyday whole-body lotion, not a spot treatment; unsuitable for long-standing hyperpigmentation.

related_not_for_underarm_darkness.name: 7% Glycolic Acid Exfoliating Body Stick
related_not_for_underarm_darkness.inci_short: 7% Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Shea Butter (full list on the kit page)
related_not_for_underarm_darkness.brand_says: For strawberry skin, bumps and ingrown hair on elbows, knees, legs. Start 2-3 times a week. Sunscreen after morning use.
